_notes: Per-instance exemptions from the lexeme blocklists. Blocklist scope is GLOBAL
(researcher, 2026-07-31): every type is validated against the global list and all
ratified per-value lists. This file is the release valve for an innocent hit, so a
single item never forces a retreat from global scope.
An exemption downgrades ONE documented hit to informational. It never suppresses:
every applied exemption is printed in docs/battery_validation_report.md, and an
exemption that stops matching is reported as stale so the list stays accurate.
Record fields:
cell       'type_id:scenario_id:condition'. The condition slot accepts '*' —
a stem hit appears in all four cells of a scenario, and one grant
covering that scenario is the honest unit rather than four copies.
field      optional; restricts the exemption to one stimulus field.
lexeme     the matched lexeme (case-insensitive).
rationale  why this instance is innocent. Required in practice — it is what a
reader needs to re-judge the call later.
date       when granted (YYYY-MM-DD).
granted_by who ratified it.
